description: Master output strip with fader, RMS and peak VU, mute with fade automation, dim, mono fold, soft clipping and a DC blocker

params.text: Sets the output level, -inf to +6dB with unity at 0dB; the VU is calibrated so that 0dB reads 10V
Mutes the output, and becomes a fade button once fade automation is turned on in the label menu
Drops the output by the amount set as the dim gain in the label menu, -12dB by default

outputs.text: Left output, after the fader, dim, mono fold, DC blocker and clipper
Right output, after the fader, dim, mono fold, DC blocker and clipper

notes: the fade time, the fade curve and the dim gain are on the module's own right-click menu, along with the box the label is typed into.
menu: Symmetrical fades — makes a fade-in and a fade-out follow mirrored curves
Fade — two sliders, the first setting the fade time from OFF to 30 seconds, the second the curve, Linear at the centre with Exp and Log either side
Dim gain — sets how far the DIM button drops the output, -30dB to -1dB, and -12dB by default
DC blocker — passes only the AC part of the output
Clipping — Soft (default), which starts at -4.44dB and reaches its limit at +1.58dB, or Hard, which holds the output to 10V
VU Colour — sets the colour of the meter
Display colour — sets the colour of the label
